name: agent-browser-bridge-extension
description: Browser extension for Chrome and Safari that exposes browser APIs to AI agents over MCP.

scripts.build:safari: npm run build && xcrun safari-web-extension-converter dist --project-location safari --app-name "Agent Browser Bridge" --bundle-identifier dev.agentbrowserbridge.app --macos-only --copy-resources --no-prompt --force
scripts.dev: vite build --mode development && (vite build --watch --mode development & vite build --watch --mode development --config vite.background.config.ts)
